description: This file defines a report for comparing stock ledger values with account values in ERPNext, including functions to fetch and process stock ledger and GL data, and to generate report columns.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and processes stock ledger and GL data, returning filtered data for report.

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_data
methods.description: Retrieves stock ledger entries based on filters and account information.

methods.name: get_gl_data
methods.description: Retrieves general ledger entries and aggregates account values.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report display.
